d:
Chhukar mere man ko kiya tune kya ishara…
80 ke dashak ka yah sadabhar romantik git “chhukar mere man ko” philm yarana (1981) ka behad lokapriy gana hai. is khubsurat git ko mahan gayak kishor kumar ne apni madhur aavaz men gaya hai.
Philm men amitabh bachchan aur nitu sinh ki shandar kemistri is gane ko aur bhi khas bana deti hai. yah git aaj bhi purane hindi ganon ke premiyon ke dilon ko chhu leta hai.
Agar aapko purane bolivud ke romantik gane pasand hain to is vidiyo ko laik karen, chainal ko sabsakraib karen aur apne doston ke sath jarur sheyar karen.
Song: Chookar Mere Mann Ko
